title: Rearrange Into an Arithmetic Progression
description: Given an integer array `nums`, determine whether its elements can be rearranged into an arithmetic progression. In such an ordering, the difference between each adjacent pair is constant. Input: `nums`. Output: true if a valid ordering exists, otherwise false.
hints: Scan once to identify the boundary or state where the answer changes.
Test already ordered, reversed, duplicate, and minimum-size inputs.
